title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten documented no-admission activities at Pomona and nearby Claremont Colleges venues.

cards.entity_name: Benton Museum of Art at Pomona College
cards.title: Browse the Benton galleries
cards.subtitle: 120 W. Bonita Ave., Claremont
cards.notes: Meet at the galleries and take a slow lap through the changing exhibitions; no ticket or purchase is needed for museum admission.
cards.short_summary: A free, public art stop at Pomona’s museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The Benton Museum of Art states that it is free and open to all.
cards.access_notes: Open during posted museum hours; check the visit page before going.

cards.entity_name: Benton Museum of Art Gallery Talks
cards.title: Join a Benton gallery talk
cards.subtitle: Benton Museum of Art, Pomona College
cards.notes: Check the museum’s weekly lineup, then join the short gallery talk and Q&A with artists, curators, students or staff.
cards.short_summary: An informal, focused art conversation in the galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: Benton gallery talks are described as free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current weekly schedule with the museum before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Pomona College Department of Music Concerts
cards.title: Catch a Pomona music concert
cards.subtitle: Pomona College performance venues
cards.notes: Use the Music at Pomona calendar to choose a department concert and arrive early enough to settle in before the performance.
cards.short_summary: Free public performances by Pomona’s music department.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona College states that all Music Department concerts are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Programs and venues vary; use the department calendar for the current listing.

cards.title: Hear the Friday Noon Concert
cards.subtitle: Balch Auditorium, Scripps College
cards.notes: Bring a friend to Balch Auditorium for the noon series, featuring faculty, visiting professionals and friends of the colleges.
cards.evidence_claim: The Friday Noon Concert Series lists admission as free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Friday Noon Concert Series | Pomona College
cards.access_notes: Doors open at noon; confirm the active term’s schedule before attending.

cards.title: Attend a Concert Choir performance
cards.subtitle: Garrison Theater, Scripps College
cards.notes: Pick a listed Concert Choir date and listen with the community in Garrison Theater; check the program page for any updates.
cards.short_summary: A free public choral performance at Scripps.
cards.evidence_claim: The Joint Music Program says Claremont Concert Choir concerts are free of charge and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Choral Concerts - The Joint Music Program
cards.access_notes: The published 2026–27 schedule is subject to change; confirm date and time before going.

cards.title: Listen to the Treble Singers
cards.subtitle: Garrison Theater, Scripps College
cards.notes: Plan around a scheduled Treble Singers concert and arrive with time to find seating in the Garrison Theater.
cards.short_summary: A separate choral program with no admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Joint Music Program says Claremont Treble Singers concerts are free of charge and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Choral Concerts - The Joint Music Program
cards.access_notes: The published 2026–27 schedule is subject to change; confirm date and time before going.

cards.title: See a Williamson Gallery exhibition
cards.subtitle: 251 E. Eleventh St., Scripps College
cards.notes: Visit during an exhibition window and spend time with the gallery’s current show; donations are welcome but not required.
cards.short_summary: Free public gallery admission on the Scripps campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ruth Chandler Williamson Gallery states that it is free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open during exhibitions Wednesday–Sunday, 12–5 p.m.; verify exhibition dates first.

cards.title: Go to a Goudy Lecture
cards.subtitle: Honnold Library, Claremont Colleges
cards.notes: Watch Scripps’ lecture listings for the next Goudy talk, then pair the talk with a walk through the neighboring colleges.
cards.short_summary: Public talks centered on books, type and book arts.
cards.evidence_claim: Scripps College states that Frederic W. Goudy Lectures are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Structures of Practice: Building Meaning Through Material and Form
cards.access_notes: Confirm the next lecture’s date, room and any attendance instructions on Scripps’ events pages.

cards.title: Reserve a free Scripps Presents program
cards.subtitle: Scripps College venues, Claremont
cards.notes: Choose a program explicitly marked free, reserve a seat if requested, and arrive before the ticket-holder seating cutoff.
cards.short_summary: Public cultural programs, with reservations often required.
cards.evidence_claim: Scripps Presents states that most of its programs are free and open to the public, with reservations required.
cards.access_notes: Only select listings explicitly identified as free; reserve seats through the current event listing when required.

cards.entity_name: City of Claremont Monday Night Concert Series
cards.title: Settle in for a Monday night concert
cards.subtitle: Memorial Park, Claremont
cards.notes: Bring a blanket or chair for the City’s summer concert series and enjoy the scheduled live performance in Memorial Park.
cards.short_summary: A City-run outdoor summer concert series.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Claremont describes its Monday Night Concert Series as a free eight-week series.
cards.source_title: 2026 Monday Night Concert Series Press Release | City of Claremont
cards.access_notes: This is a seasonal series; check the City’s current announcement for the lineup and weather updates.
